public_reply_templates.label: Standard — most common
public_reply_templates.trigger: They ask for info, contact, or how to reach us
public_reply_templates.template:
Of course! Here's everything you need 🧹

📞 Office (call): [CAMPAIGN PHONE NUMBER]
📱 Cell (call or text): 773-349-7935
🌐 [CAMPAIGN URL]
📘 Follow us on Facebook: [CAMPAIGN URL]

Feel free to call or text the cell — we're local to Chicago and happy to work something out!
notes: Emoji used as visual separators — easy to scan on mobile
Office labeled 'call only' — prevents lost leads from SMS to wrong number
Cell labeled 'call or text' = lowers the barrier (texting feels easier than calling)
'Work something out' = flexible, collaborative tone — not 'book now'
Facebook link at end = encourages follow naturally

public_reply_templates.label: Short version — when they just say 'interested!'
public_reply_templates.trigger: Short positive reply — 'We're interested!', 'Love this!', 'Need this!'
public_reply_templates.template: Awesome — glad to hear it! Give us a call at [CAMPAIGN PHONE NUMBER] and we'll get something set up. You can also check us out at [CAMPAIGN URL] 🧹
notes: Matches their energy — short and enthusiastic
Office number only — cell stays private unless they ask for a number to text
Website as secondary option for those who prefer browsing first
No info dump — keeps it conversational

public_reply_templates.label: When they say 'DM me' or 'Message me'
public_reply_templates.trigger: They explicitly ask to be contacted privately
public_reply_templates.template: Will do! Sending you a message now — you can also reach us at [CAMPAIGN PHONE NUMBER] or [CAMPAIGN URL] if it's easier 🧹
notes: Leaves public comment short — details go in the DM
Gives them direct contact as backup
Bot then sends DM with full D1 template content
